title: explore/network-inventory.json: the module's traffic shapes, written only by scripts/explore.mjs ingest-network and build (D-052). Key names only: never values, cookies, tokens or headers. scripts/lib/endpoints.mjs cites an entry as explore/network-inventory.json#NI-<m>-<n>.

id.description: Stable id per method + host + path template (explore/registry/network.json), never reused.

host.description: Present when the request went to a host other than the target's.

requestKeys.description: Body key names (JSON keys or form field names).

responseKeys.description: Top-level JSON key names of the response (of its items for an array).

pages.description: Slugs of the pages the requests were captured on.

operationType.description: unknown: a persisted query without its document; treated as mutating.
